title: EXploratory Study on Postprandial Energy Metabolism
official: Efficacy of Probiotics on Postprandial Energy Metabolism of Adults With Overweight or Obesity: an EXploratory Clinical Trial
summary: This exploratory, double-blinded clinical trial on 66 randomized adults aged 50 to 70 years with moderate overweight or obesity but considered metabolically healthy will consist of comparing metabolic and microbiota parameters before and after 3 months of consumption of a probiotic or a placebo.

sites.f: Centre de Recherche en Nutrition Humaine Rhône-Alpes (CRNH-RA)
